interpretation.completion: Every fully completed source set increments TimesCompleted once, not only Normal/Hard/Bonus.
interpretation.showcomplete: Only the preceding authored next/gonext entry requests showcomplete.
interpretation.mirror: Repeat the same current source sprite and remap at source reflected foot coordinate; no vertical art flip. Native ground foot 248-nativeY follows the existing 4/5 coordinate adapter. Air/fixed-point/depth remain explicit compatibility adaptations.
interpretation.unlock: Saved completion counter must meet the selected source ifcomplete threshold.
